name: TAFE Queensland fee payment plan
summary: Domestic students with tuition fees of $300 or more can pay in instalments instead of upfront.
key: TAFE Queensland will provide the option for deferred payment of Tuition Fees through a Payment Plan.
who: Not FEE-HELP eligible and no outstanding debt with TAFE Queensland.
how: Request the plan at enrolment or before your study start date.
catches: Two consecutive missed instalments cancel the plan and the full balance becomes payable.

evidence.quote: TAFE Queensland will provide the option for deferred payment of Tuition Fees through a Payment Plan.
Payment Plans must be requested at the time of enrolment or prior to the start of study date
